#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string string_input;
    std::getline(std::cin, string_input);
    std::string modified_str = string_input[0] + string_input.substr(1).replace(0, 2, "@");
    size_t pos = 1;
    size_t count = 0;
    while ((pos = modified_str.find("at", pos)) != std::string::npos && count < 1) {
        modified_str.replace(pos, 2, "@");
        pos += 1;
        count++;
    }
    std::string final_str = modified_str[0] + modified_str.substr(1, modified_str.size() - 2).replace(0, 3, ".") + modified_str.back();
    size_t start_pos = 1;
    size_t end_pos = final_str.size() - 1;
    std::string middle_part = final_str.substr(start_pos, end_pos - start_pos);
    size_t pos_dot = 0;
    while ((pos_dot = middle_part.find("dot", pos_dot)) != std::string::npos) {
        middle_part.replace(pos_dot, 3, ".");
        pos_dot += 1;
    }
    final_str = final_str[0] + middle_part + final_str.back();
    std::cout << final_str << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
